sentences.text: Office has raised an objection that in fact a Miscellaneous Appeal should have been filed in place of Civil Revision.

It is submitted by counsel for applicant that either he may granted a week's time to file an application seeking permission of this Court to convert this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal or his verbal prayer for conversion of this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal may be accepted.
Considered the submissions made by counsel for applicant.
The applicant has filed this civil revision for enhancement of compensation amount.

Therefore, verbal prayer made by counsel for applicant for conversion of this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:4431 2 CR-440-2025 allowed.

Accordingly, subject to payment of Court fees within a period of two weeks' from today, office is directed to register this case in the category of Miscellaneous Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act.

With aforesaid observation, this Civil Revision is disposed of.

In this case, on ERP at serial No.1,
office has uploaded a copy of order dated 22.04.2025 passed by this Court in M.A. No.3218/2025 which was filed by Santosh Dhakad arising out of an award passed in MACC No.208/2022, whereas the present Civil Revision was filed against an award passed in MACC No.391/2019.

From the status of M.A. No.3218/2025, it is clear that said Miscellaneous Appeal was subsequently allowed by order dated 10.05.2025 passed in Lok Adalat, therefore, this Court has failed to understand the relevancy of the order dated 22.04.2025 passed in M.A. No.3218/2025.
Accordingly, office is directed to either point out the relevancy of the said order or immediately remove the copy of order dated 22.04.2025 passed in M.A. No.3218/2025 from serial No.1 from the ERP.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This civil revision under Section 115 of CPC has been filed against the award dated 17/01/2025 passed by Second Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ambah District Morena in M.A.C.C.
No.391/2019.
Office has raised an objection that in fact a Miscellaneous Appeal should have been filed in place of Civil Revision.
opennyai_summary.decision:
It is submitted by counsel for applicant that either he may granted a week's time to file an application seeking permission of this Court to convert this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal or his verbal prayer for conversion of this Civil Revision into Miscellaneous Appeal may be accepted.
The applicant has filed this civil revision for enhancement of compensation amount.
Accordingly, subject to payment of Court fees within a period of two weeks' from today, office is directed to register this case in the category of Miscellaneous Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act.
With aforesaid observation, this Civil Revision is disposed of.
From the status of M.A. No.3218/2025, it is clear that said Miscellaneous Appeal was subsequently allowed by order dated 10.05.2025 passed in Lok Adalat, therefore, this Court has failed to understand the relevancy of the order dated 22.04.2025 passed in M.A. No.3218/2025.
Accordingly, office is directed to either point out the relevancy of the said order or immediately remove the copy of order dated 22.04.2025 passed in M.A. No.3218/2025 from serial No.1 from the ERP.
